markets.rules_primary: If the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' BRTI before 1:30 PM EDT on Oct 28, 2026 is at least the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' BRTI before 1:15 PM EDT on October 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

If the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' BRTI before 1:15 PM EDT on Oct 28, 2026 is at least the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' BRTI before 1:00 PM EDT on October 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

If the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' BRTI before 1:00 PM EDT on Oct 28, 2026 is at least the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' BRTI before 12:45 PM EDT on October 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
